scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive enumeration has a stated completeness proof and is supplied with executable exact arithmetic. No external verification or novelty guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one infectious contact per infected vertex and a deterministic seed on connected unweighted finite trees; no statement about cycles, other transmission protocols, or practical effect size. The earliest cited foundational public source is arXiv:q-bio/0610057v1, posted 2006-10-30.
title: A fourteen-vertex threshold for nonleaf optimal epidemic seeds on trees
